_comment: Copy to laminar.dev.json (gitignored) to trace chat and agent turns into a locally self-hosted Laminar. See AGENTS.md, 'Tracing agent and chat turns (Laminar, dev)'. Delete the file to switch tracing off.
_maxCharsComment: Optional. How much of each recorded message list to keep; the Pi extension's own default of 20000 clips the newest messages and hides the prompt of every turn after the first.
